result.rationale: The diff shows poll_feed.rb line `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` called unconditionally for every `rss.items`, with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, and the poll_feed_spec only stubs SiteSetting gates — it never exercises poll_feed with a real feed, so the nil-content path is untested. Whether SimpleRSS exposes `content` for plain RSS 2.0 items depends on the external gem (its content:encoded mapping), which cannot be verified from the diff, but the described mechanism (nil → NoMethodError aborting the hourly poll) is consistent with the code shown.

judged_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — [P1, conf 75] `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` assumes every feed item has a `<content>` element, but standard RSS 2.0 items carry only `<description>`/`content:encoded`, so `i.content` is nil, NoMethodError aborts the whole poll (retry: false) and no item is ever imported; the spec only tests the setting gates and never exercises poll_feed with a real feed.
